title: Handlers that take the role for an admin action, and the user whose projects are listed, from client-supplied fields instead of the verified session

planted.why: set_quota reads the role from the request body and falls back to the session only when it is absent, so any member sends {"role": "admin"} and sets quotas
list_projects filters by a user_id from the query string, so any logged-in user lists any other user's private projects

proof.python:
import handlers as h
h.create_project({'session': {'user_id': 'u2', 'role': 'member'}, 'body': {'name': 'secret'}, 'query': {}})
r = h.set_quota({'session': {'user_id': 'u1', 'role': 'member'}, 'body': {'role': 'admin', 'project_id': 1, 'quota': 9}, 'query': {}})
assert r['status'] == 200 and h.QUOTAS == {1: 9}
r = h.list_projects({'session': {'user_id': 'u1', 'role': 'member'}, 'body': {}, 'query': {'user_id': 'u2'}})
assert [p['name'] for p in r['body']] == ['secret']
